chapter: Bird memories, cabaret card and Prestige years
title: Living on East Houston Street
summary: In 1956-57 McLean lived on the Lower East Side where there was little music scene, and Bird visited.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Where were you living in this period?
So you were by ’56, ’57, on the Lower East Side.
Oh yeah. I was already down there.
Was there much of a scene there with musicians and artists at that point?
It was still the west Village.

It was still – yeah, everybody that was anybody living in the Village was living over there, in that part of town. Bird would come over on our side, to see – come to my house or visit some other painters or people that lived in that area.
